items.title: Cognizant Establishes 25,000-Person Claude AI Group and Introduces Enterprise Managed Services
items.summary: Cognizant (NASDAQ:CTSH) announced the creation of its Claude Frontier Capability Group, a dedicated organisation comprising more than 25,000 professionals focused on implementing Anthropic’s Claude artificial intelligence technology for enterprise customers. The IT services company also introduced a managed services offering for Claude-powered systems, under which Cognizant will assume responsibility for operating and maintaining AI solutions on behalf of clients.
